text: {"lessons":["My account has risen overall without any trades, reinforcing that patience can be valuable when I have no clear reason to act.","A few monthly gains or losses are noisy and do not reliably predict what comes next, so I should avoid reacting to short-term fluctuations.","I should assess positions in the context of my whole portfolio and goals, rather than treating each stock as a separate account or anchoring on its purchase price."]}
